property_summary: After locking in a guess, settling is impossible until more than one block has passed (stored block = block.number + 1, and settle needs block.number > stored block), so a settle call in the very next block must revert in the correct contract; the mutant stores block.number and thus lets settle succeed immediately in the next block.
change_summary: Record block.number instead of block.number + 1 as the guess block.
